description: Fork of exp732 (4K, val=1.3912 @ 276.8M). Merge separate qk_lut (H=6, NAP=4, tph=256, n_out=2*d_qk=128) and v_lut (H=6, NAP=6, tph=256, n_out=d_v=64) into a single unified qkv_lut with n_heads=H=6, n_anchor_pairs=6, tables_per_head=256, n_outputs=2*d_qk+d_v=192. Per-head anchor routing is shared between q, k and v (was independent qk vs v); q and k inherit v's wider K=64. Output reshape: qkv_lut output (B*T, H, 192) -> split last dim into q (..., d_qk), k (..., d_qk), v (..., d_v); then q_norm/k_norm and RoPE as before. LUT params per layer: old qk+v 9.44M -> new qkv 18.87M (+9.43M/layer = +56.6M for 6 layers). Total model ~333M (vs 276.8M exp732). Same 4K-step LR schedule. All other modules (out_proj NAP=7 tph=512, residual NAP=6 tph=256, emb_resid NAP=6 tph=256) unchanged. Expected wallclock ~1.5-1.8 h (Phase D GEMM ~2x bigger than exp732's qk+v combined; Phase H bmm-wgrad path active).
